{{Quote|He's a master of false identity preparation. Maybe the most famous one alive. Though we didn't know for sure that he was alive. He disappeared years ago. We assumed he'd made himself a new identity and retired.|Myri Antilles, on Usan Joyl|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Usan Joyl''' was an elder [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was an infamous con artist and identity forger.<ref name="MK" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he and his grandson, [[Dashan Joyl|Dashan]], were imprisoned by corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] within the lower levels of the [[Vandor-3]] [[Caridan]] [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat|animal exhibit]] from where Thaal ran his criminal operations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the Joyls' imprisonment, Thaal used the elder Joyl for his identity-forging talents in order to create his new persona of [[Stavin Thaal|Thadley Biolan]], which he would use to retire from the military.<ref name="MK" />

Prior to Thaal's upcoming retirement, the Joyls were rescued by [[Wraith Squadron]] members [[Myri Antilles]], who was familiar of Joyl's work and idolized him for it, and [[Trey Courser]]. Usan and Dashan joined the whole of Wraith Squadron in escaping the animal exhibit when the squad was found out by the security forces, and both Duros joined the male members of the squad in holing up, for several [[Standard day|days]] at [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]]. During this time, Joyl informed the Wraiths about Thaal's plans, but both he and Dashan failed to come up with any motive. Regardless, the Joyls joined the Wraiths in escaping Vandor-3 and gaining their freedom, and the information that Usan provided proved valuable in successfully completing the mission on [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Usan Joyl, along with his grandson [[Dashan Joyl|Dashan]], were created by veteran ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Aaron Allston]] in his tenth and latest installment of the popular [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-wing'' novels]]. Usan's character was meant to explain what the goals of [[Wraith Squadron]]'s target, [[Stavin Thaal]], were. The information provided by Joyl was an essential key in bringing Thaal to justice by the novel's end.<ref name="MK" />
